documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V1.0: TPU 95A HF
Bambu TPU 95A HF Safety Data Sheet SDS20251127U01
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: TPU 95A HF
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 22.3 ± 0.6 MPa, elongation > 480%, impact 86.3 kJ/m²) are not stored. Density and melting temperature are raw-material properties from the TDS Physical Properties table and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 9.8 ± 0.7 MPa, Z 7.4 ± 0.6 MPa), melt index 36.5 ± 2.6 g/10 min (210 °C, 2.16 kg), saturated water absorption rate 1.08% (25 °C, 55% RH), crystallization temperature N/A, spool material PC + ABS (temperature resistance 90 °C), spool size 200 × 67 mm, printing and storage humidity < 20% RH (sealed with desiccant), retraction length 0.8 - 1.4 mm, retraction speed 20 - 40 mm/s, chamber temperature 25 - 45 °C, max overhang angle ~ 55°, max bridging length 20 mm, X1 Series heatbed drying 80 - 90 °C 12 h, the advice not to anneal TPU prints, odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products.
The TDS recommended chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability, not a filament print setting.
Elongation at break is kept as the text "> 650%" (data type number, no value_num): the TDS gives only a lower bound, and storing 650 would claim an equality the document does not make.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: product name "Bambu TPU 95A HF", model "U01-xx", CLP "Not classified", conditions to avoid ("Avoid fire, elevated temperatures. direct sunlight.") and "Not hazardous goods" for sea (IMDG), DOT, road (ADR/RID) and air (ICAO-TI/IATA) transport. Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values.

Source disagreements kept for review: nozzle temperature (TDS 220 - 240 °C vs material-table wiki 200 - 250 °C ±10 °C); bed temperature (TDS 30 - 35 °C vs material-table wiki 30 - 45 °C with glue, 35 - 45 ℃ on Smooth PEI / Textured PEI); Cool Plate (listed by the TDS, "Not recommended" in the material-table wiki); AMS HT drying time (drying wiki 18 h vs material-table wiki 12 h, both 75 °C). The product TDS values are kept.

Marketing prose proves no number: "a print speed that's 3 times faster than standard TPU 95A" (store page and TDS Basic Info) and the Highlights ("High-speed printing TPU", "Soft, Flexible & Tough", "Outstanding Impact Resistance and Flexibility") are not stored as values.

not_published: the TDS states "N/A" for the glass transition temperature, the Vicat softening temperature, the heat deflection temperature (both 1.8 MPa and 0.45 MPa rows), and the bending strength and bending modulus; filament length and hardness are stated in none of the documents searched. The product name carries "95A", the usual Shore A hardness grade, but no document states a hardness value or a test method, so mechanical.hardness is not inferred from the name (for review).
Hex: all 6 colours of the hex table match a store Colour value by name (White, Gray, Yellow, Blue, Red, Black); the table names colours without codes.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament (the store page has no What's in the Box section).
material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.03 mm) is the store page's own row (Product Features › bullet 5); the TDS gives no tolerance, so it is not restated here and not marked not_published.

The store page links a "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/925d913ab89b4707990b5c00cc239c52.pdf) that was not cached and not read, so safety.certifications is neither curated nor marked not_published. The store FAQ's "TPU Printing Guide" carries no link on the page, and the wiki has no /en/filament/<family> page for TPU, so no TPU usage guide was read.

The store has no Refill value for TPU 95A HF (Type group: "Filament with spool" only), so no spool requirement is recorded. The store FAQ (4.Safety Tips) says the filament "is not food-grade"; the same list also says it "contains highly hygroscopic wood fibers", which contradicts the TDS and SDS composition (thermoplastic polyurethane, 99-99.9 % by wt) and reads as a copied sentence. No registry key holds either, and neither is stored.

Adjudication against the second extraction (83 field disagreements, each checked in the cached documents). Same fact, this file's form kept (29): the hex locators (row and column checked in the hex table layout: White/Gray, Yellow/Blue, Red/Black); the TDS Nozzle Size row as one relation for the 0.4, 0.6 and 0.8 mm nozzles (the second cited the wiki nozzle row and split it into one row per nozzle); and the single store "All AMS Series NOT Compatible" family row, which already covers the second's wiki AMS and AMS lite rows (material-table wiki, 3. AMS & AMS lite, row "TPU": "Not Compatible"). Kept after checking the documents (22): material.type stays the TDS p.3 Composition cell "Thermoplastic polyurethane" (the second's "TPU" is an abbreviation the quote does not contain); material.spool_type stays the unverified store bullet (Product Features › bullet 4); the All AMS Series row (store Cautions for Use › bullet 2) and the four plate target handles stay (the Smooth PEI plate's own store page names it "Bambu High Temperature Plate (Smooth PEI)"); mechanical.hardness stays not_published: "95A" is only in the product name ("TPU 95A HF"), and no cached document (TDS, SDS, hex table, both wiki pages, store page) states a hardness value or a test method, so the second's unverified "95A" read from the TDS title is not written. Taken from the second after checking the documents (32): extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters (TDS p.1 Nozzle Size "0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm"), the high flow nozzle row (material-table wiki, 2. Nozzle, row "TPU 95A HF"), the open-frame / enclosed printer row (material-table wiki, row "TPU"; written as one all_bambu_printers family row, as in the other filament files), and, for Glue, target_kind "other" and the relation recommended_with (the TDS row sits under "Recommended Printing Settings" and no document says glue is required for TPU). material.net_weight is written in kg, the TDS's own figure (1 kg; the runner stores it as 1000 g with the text "1 kg").

Quote check: every TDS quote from the p.1 "Printing and Storage Humidity" row through the p.2 "Breaking Elongation Rate (X-Y)" row (density, melting temperature, tensile strength, nozzle and bed temperature, printing speed, cooling fan, build plate type, nozzle size, bed surface preparation) is verbatim in the TDS text layer, but the cache checker reads the text from "< 20% RH" to "> 650%" as one HTML tag and drops it, so it reports them not_found. Checked with the PDF text left unstripped: all 34 quotes found, no value missing from its quote.
